graduation_records: school = school of its programme

student_programmes: level = level of its programme
applications: level = level of its programme

delivery mode of every term enrolment is offered by its programme
course enrolments use their term's delivery mode and their programme's courses
registrar/students: residency status consistent with nationality
admissions/applicants: residency status consistent with nationality
student demographics equal their applicant record

reference/programmes: labelled as synthetic placeholders (not verified names)

no synthetic file mixes UCI rows (no combined population or totals)
term dates ordered (start < census < end) and terms do not overlap
term_status consistent with the as-of date (COMPLETED iff end <= as-of; FUTURE iff start > as-of)
reporting_status / grades_final_available / census_passed consistent with the as-of date
academic_year labels follow Fall Y + Spring/Summer Y+1
academic years span their terms and carry a status consistent with the as-of date
grades_final = True exactly for completed terms (no future/in-progress term marked completed)
final course grades exist only in completed terms
no enrolment before admission (every enrolment term starts on/after its admission date)
admitted application (submitted <= decided < admission, same programme/term) for every non-internal admission
first enrolment of each admission is in its entry term (cohort census)
every admission has at least one term enrolment
study_term_number counts enrolled terms 1..n within each admission
exactly one FIRST_ADMISSION per student, and it is the earliest
programme changes / next degrees / readmissions link to a matching earlier outcome
programme transfers valid: same level, different programme, next regular term, credits <= earned
no enrolment after graduation/withdrawal/dismissal/change in the same admission (outcome term = last enrolled term)
no simultaneous enrolment in two programmes (one enrolment per student per term)
a student's programme admissions never overlap
at most one ACTIVE programme per student
graduations valid: term-end date, completed term, not after as-of, credits, minimum duration, GPA
outcome dates = end of outcome term, recorded on/after it, never after the as-of date
outcome fields present exactly when an outcome exists (withdrawal type only for withdrawals)
prior_gap_terms recomputes from the enrolment history
no gap inside one admission exceeds the configured limit (3 regular terms)
missed-term withdrawal rule (> 3 regular terms -> UNOFFICIAL withdrawal at next census) recomputes
no enrolments, grades, charges, standing, admissions, cohorts, events or graduations in FUTURE terms
future-term applications are not enrolled and are decided on/before the as-of date (or PENDING)
in-progress term (census snapshot only): no final grades, GPA, standing, performance flags or graduations
no recorded event after the as-of date
status history recomputes from admissions and enrolments (admission event never overwritten)
grade points match the grading scheme
course credits earned follow the pass mark
semester GPA and cumulative GPA recompute from course grades
term and cumulative credits earned recompute from course grades (incl. transferred credits)
academic standing (good / warning / probation / dismissed) recomputes, carried forward when ungraded
exactly one standing row per completed term enrolment; none for incomplete terms
poor-performance flag and pass ratio recompute with the configured rule
every student is in exactly one INSTITUTIONAL cohort
exactly one LEVEL_ENTRY membership per student per level (first admission at that level)
frozen entry attributes equal the census-term enrolment
every charge belongs to an actual term enrolment
every term enrolment is billed tuition
charge amounts: positive fees, negative scholarships
financial holds recompute from charges and payments
hold status_as_of consistent with release date
no registration while a financial hold is active
every registration block coincides with an active hold
blocked students are not enrolled in the blocked term
past-due balances recompute at the as-of date
has_active_hold flag equals the recomputed active holds
payments are positive and validly dated on/before the as-of date
successful logins only while the account is active
student account created before the first term starts
server status uptime and downtime agree
one incident per non-operational server day
sync runs fail exactly on ETL/database outage days
retention membership = every INSTITUTIONAL cohort member + every base-term enrolment (no more, no less)
retention outcomes recompute independently (retained same programme / transfer / completed / stopped out / left)
retention rates recompute: retained / (cohort - completed); programme retention; completions separate
retained + completed + continuing (optional summer) + stopped out + left = denominator (100 %)
optional Summer: students enrolled the following Fall are never classified as stopped out or left
programme retained <= institutionally retained; retained excludes graduates
filtered groups (level, school, programme, mode, load) add up to the whole comparison
first-year Fall 2025 -> Fall 2026 cohort retention is FINAL_CENSUS_SNAPSHOT (Fall 2026 census passed, term in progress)
Spring 2026 -> Spring 2027 and Summer 2026 -> Summer 2027 are INCOMPLETE (future terms)
no FINAL retention is measured in a future term
multi-year cohort retention: enrolled + completed + on gap + left = cohort size
one graduation record per LEVEL_ENTRY cohort member
graduation records recompute independently (window, maturity, status, dates, time-to-degree)
final graduation rates recompute (UG 6 y, Master's 4 y, Doctorate 6 y; mature cohorts only)
immature cohorts publish no final graduation rate
configured windows are UG 6, Master's 4, Doctorate 6 years (project-configured reporting assumptions)
graduates are kept separate from enrolled students (no enrolment in a graduated admission after graduation)
time-to-degree summary covers every graduation record with a graduation date
enrolment by term x school x programme x level x mode x load x gender x residency x nationality sums to headcount
the in-progress term is labelled CENSUS_SNAPSHOT_ONLY in enrolment outputs
performance outputs use completed terms only
credit-weighted term GPA by term and level recomputes from course grades
standing counts add up to completed enrolments
